pages.text: Anas ibn Malik (may Allah be pleased with him) had a little brother called Abu Umair, and he had a nughar that he played with — a little bird.
Whenever the Prophet ﷺ came, he would say to him: “O Abu Umair, what did the nughayr do?” (Sahih al-Bukhari 6203) — asking him about his little bird.
Anas said: “The Prophet ﷺ was the best of people in character.” (Sahih al-Bukhari 6203)
Anas said: “I served the Prophet ﷺ for ten years, and he never said to me ‘uff’.” (Sahih al-Bukhari 6038)
